mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% signals labor market weakness triggering monetary policy easing, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 7.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS < 400000) signals recessionary labor and demand conditions, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE > 7.5% AND RSAFS < 400000 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in instances where INDPRO is above 100 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 800 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reaction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in instances where HOUST < 800 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as future rate hikes are priced in.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in instances where CPIAUCSL > 230 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Supply shock regime (INDPRO < 95) reduces economic output and increases inflationary pressures, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in instances where INDPRO < 95 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
